reviews.text:
Our group of seven just finished a private Balkan tour with Almedin, and I can honestly say he was one of the biggest reasons this trip was such a success.

His knowledge of Balkan history was outstanding. He didn’t just tell us what we were looking at, he connected the history of Yugoslavia, the Ottoman Empire, the Byzantine Empire, and even ancient Greek influence to the architecture, culture, food, and people of each country we visited. Every drive and walking tour turned into a fascinating history lesson.

Beyond his knowledge, Almedin genuinely cares about his guests. When one person in our group had a minor moped accident, he immediately accompanied her to the hospital, stayed with her, translated everything, and made sure she was okay before returning to the group. That level of care speaks volumes about his character.

Throughout the trip, he went above and beyond, helping translate conversations, arranging restaurant reservations, recommending fantastic local spots, and always being flexible to our group’s needs. He also wasn’t afraid to stand up for what was right. We even saw him step in when a taxi driver attempted to overcharge members of our group. That kind of integrity gave us a lot of confidence throughout the trip.

He also has an incredible personality. He’s funny, personable, and has stories for days. He has a way of making everyone feel included and intentionally engages with the group instead of simply reciting facts.

The itinerary itself is fast-paced, but that’s the nature of the tour we chose, not a reflection of Almedin. Everything was well organized, and the private transportation he arranged was comfortable and reliable.

I would recommend Almedin without hesitation to anyone visiting the Balkans, whether you’re traveling as a family, with friends, or you’re simply someone who wants to truly understand the history and culture of the region rather than just see the sights. He is passionate about what he does, incredibly knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about giving his guests the best experience possible.

Thank you, Almedin, for making this a trip we’ll never forget!

We had the most wonderful evening cooking and sharing a meal with Đula, Eda, and Almedin! Đula & Eda were amazing teachers and helped us learn to make Burek & Klepe. Not only were we able to eat the delicious foods we made, they shared many other tasty Bosnian dishes and coffee with us! Their lovely home has a beautiful garden as well. I highly recommend taking a cooking class with them, it was one of our very favorite highlights of visiting Sarajevo. Thank you all so much for the excellent class!

Meme was a fantastic tour guide for us. He drove us around the whole of Herzegovina and we created some good memories. He was knowledgeable and genuinely more like a friend for the day than a tour guide, though he is incredibly across the detail of pretty much of all aspects of Bosnian history, culture and tourism. We had stops at all stops on our booking but Meme also drove us to a fantastic river club near Kravica where we had lunch - the best part of the day.

This was a private tour with just the 2 of us and Meme and there were never any moments of boredom or awkwardness. It was a genuinely fantastic experience and I would recommend Meme above everyone else in Bosnia to provide a fun and comprehensive experience in the country. Meme, thank you so much - we had so much fun.
Very helpful for all of the day trips information. Me and my family did a three day Bosnian tour, and it was very interesting and fun. Definitely recommend.
nice walk through sarajevo，history and daily life ， good experience
